description: This file is a script that performs static analysis and inventory collection for plugin extension import boundaries within a TypeScript codebase, specifically focusing on certain plugin directories and enforcing architectural rules. It includes functions to collect, compare, and format inventory data, as well as to run checks against baseline fixtures.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason for ordering purposes.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Provides a descriptive reason string based on the type of import and its resolved path, indicating whether it is an extension implementation, entrypoint, or extension-owned file from src/plugins.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes a source file for module specifiers that violate import boundary rules based on path resolution and categorizes these violations.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects potential issues or 'smells' in the web search registry related to plugin import boundaries, specifically within 'src/plugins/web-search-providers.ts'.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped during inventory collection based on its path.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Main exported function that asynchronously collects an inventory of import boundary violations in plugin extension files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Diffs the expected and actual inventory entries to detect differences.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats inventory data into a human-readable string for reporting.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the inventory check comparing actual collected data with baseline expected data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the check, utilizing command-line args and output streams.
